caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor scene. A bare-backed performer, seen from behind with a small tattoo on the upper shoulder blade and long pale arm sleeves on both arms, holds two fan-shaped wire-frame props raised overhead. Flames burn at the tips of the radiating spokes while smoke plumes drift upward and vary in density. The performer turns the fans, so the curved arcs and spokes reorient, the right fan's arc tilting from a steep diagonal toward a flatter sweep near the top as the left fan likewise shifts. The arms remain raised throughout, with only small changes in wrist and elbow angle as the props are manipulated. The framing gradually reveals more of the upper flame arc, the performer's head sitting lower in the frame. Behind the action, a stone staircase with white balusters and a seated dark cat occupies the left. Green palm- and pine-like foliage fills the right against the dark sky.
